description: A stale `dist`, built while the widget still spread `{ 'ARIA-LABEL': 'Items' }` into its `host` block: the linker carries `ARIA-LABEL` into `hostAttrs` as written (measured through ngc in partial mode), and the DOM gives the host `aria-label`. Point 3 cannot see it, and point 2 reports it only while its package read takes the name in any case. Every other case of the fold holds that point 2's two reads agree; this one holds the fold itself, which a point 2 reading both sides exactly would let through. It stood on a spread the source read passed over until the read followed it (`speaking-attribute-spread-into-a-host`); a stale `dist` leans on no gap of the scanner.
